entities.title: Space scene
entities.summary: The 3D picture of the bubble, the hangar and the title, and the orbit camera.
entities.purpose: space.gd draws the player's ship at the origin and every object of the bubble where the sim puts it, interpolated between ticks, with the starfield and exhaust shaders; orbit_camera.gd is the space-anchored or follow orbit camera.
boundaries: Positions and orientations come from the sim; the camera never reaches it.
